title: Prioritize factory assignment by customer
subtitle: When enabled, orders from assigned customers are forced to their assigned factory at import time (takes priority over product config). Unassigned customers still follow product config. Each customer belongs to only 1 factory — drag customers between columns then click Save.
leaveConfirm: You have UNSAVED changes to customer/factory assignment. Leaving will discard them — continue anyway?

import.title: Import customer tiers
import.description: Upload a .xlsx / .csv / .txt file or paste directly, one line each: ACCOUNT NAME  VIP 0..5. Matches by SKU (case-insensitive), applies to every email with that SKU; accounts not in the list are skipped.
import.pastePlaceholder:
Or paste here, e.g.:
TIENHC	VIP 0
MERCHFOX	VIP 2
import.noValidRows: No valid rows found (format: ACCOUNT NAME + VIP 0..5)
import.resultSuccess: Assigned tier to {{updated}} customers ({{matched}} accounts matched).
import.resultSkipped: Skipped {{count}} accounts not in the list:
import.toastSuccess: Assigned tier to {{updated}} customers ({{matched}} accounts matched)
